audit_findings.title: Debt may be double-counted against an equity-style earnings numerator
audit_findings.magnitude: computed maximum indicated correction: $336.747 million, or $8.15/share
audit_findings.mechanism: If OE is an after-interest equity cash flow and debt principal is also deducted in the bridge, removing that bridge deduction increases equity value dollar-for-dollar.
audit_findings.evidence: The reconciling amounts between consolidated income before tax and consolidated income from operations are net interest income (expense), net and other, and foreign exchange gain (loss).
audit_findings.explanation: This is an unresolved methodology possibility, not a demonstrated error, because the OE starting measure and interest treatment are not supplied. Even the maximum correction raises values only to $87.02 bear, $100.80 base, and $116.97 bull; the corrected bull value remains 34% below the $177.56 market price, so it cannot change the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Trace each OE year to its starting earnings measure and interest adjustments; rerun without the $336.747 million debt deduction if OE is confirmed as levered equity cash flow without net borrowing or principal repayment.

audit_findings.title: Recurring stock compensation could be stripped without matching future dilution
audit_findings.magnitude: filed 2025 after-tax stock compensation of $12.929 million, equal to 4.9% of anchor OE; computed conditional value effect of $3.72-$5.19/share
audit_findings.mechanism: Adding recurring stock compensation back to OE without modeling future issuance or offsetting repurchases inflates OE and operating value attributable to current shares.
audit_findings.evidence: The Company currently intends to award only performance-based stock units (“PSUs”) and/or time-based restricted stock units (“RSUs”).
audit_findings.explanation: Recurring grants are demonstrated, but an improper OE add-back is not demonstrated from the supplied calculation. If the full filed 2025 after-tax expense had been added back, reversing it would reduce the scenario values by approximately $3.72-$5.19/share; the bull value would still be about $103.63 versus the $177.56 price. It therefore affects valuation precision but not the conclusion at the filed scale.
audit_findings.action: Inspect the OE reconciliation for every year; if stock compensation was added back, rerun with the recurring expense retained or with explicit annual issuance, PSU settlement, and offsetting-repurchase assumptions.

audit_findings.title: Material derivative liabilities may be absent from the bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: filed June 30, 2026 derivative liabilities of $59.525 million less derivative assets of $9.491 million equals $50.034 million net, or $1.21/share
audit_findings.mechanism: Any derivative settlement not already reflected in OE, debt economics, or OCI-linked hedge cash flows would require a net bridge deduction.
audit_findings.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the aggregate fair values of the Company’s derivative instruments on the Consolidated Balance Sheet were comprised of an asset of $ 13.7 million, of which $ 13.1 million is included in other current assets , and the balance of $ 0.6 million as other non-current assets , and of a noncurrent liability of $ 80.9 million included as deferred income tax and other long-term liabilities .
audit_findings.explanation: The derivative balances are demonstrated, but omission from value is unresolved because the instruments hedge interest-rate and foreign-exchange exposures and their cash flows may already enter OE or debt economics. Even treating the entire $50.034 million net liability as an additional claim lowers the bull value only to $107.61, still 39% below the market price.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile each June 2026 derivative by hedge designation, maturity, underlying exposure, OCI balance, and projected settlement; deduct only net cash claims not already captured in OE or debt.

audit_findings.title: The 2025 anchor may retain a nonrecurring property-sale gain
audit_findings.magnitude: filed Gallatin gain of $12.9 million and total 2025 net disposal gains of $16.502 million; computed maximum after-tax amount of $12.310 million and value effect of $3.54-$4.94/share
audit_findings.mechanism: A disposal gain left in 2025 OE raises the perpetual anchor and therefore every projected OE cash flow and terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: In July 2025, the Company sold its existing facility in Gallatin, Tennessee which is part of the Company’s Administrative and All Other segment for approximately $ 19.0 million in net proceeds after closing costs and sale price adjustments, which resulted in a gain on disposal of fixed assets of $ 12.9 million.
audit_findings.explanation: The nonrecurring gain is demonstrated, but its inclusion in the $264.5 million anchor is not. Conservatively assuming all $16.502 million of 2025 net disposal gains remained in OE, applying the filed 25.4% effective tax rate would reduce anchor OE by $12.310 million and scenario values by approximately $3.54-$4.94/share. The adjusted bull value would remain about $103.88 versus $177.56, so the investment conclusion would not change.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile the 2025 OE anchor to net income or operating cash flow and remove every disposal gain after tax; verify that the $28.432 million of asset-sale proceeds was not separately included as operating cash flow.

audit_findings.title: Deferred-compensation share awards are not fully reconciled to the denominator
audit_findings.magnitude: filed June 30, 2026 mezzanine award balance of $8.840 million, equal to $0.21/share and 0.23% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: An unfunded redemption obligation belongs in the bridge, while stock-settled awards not already reflected in shares belong in the diluted denominator; recognizing neither overstates per-share value.
audit_findings.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2025, the Company presented the equity balances related to “ Non-qualified deferred compensation plan share awards ” as mezzanine equity for $ 7.8 million and $ 5.7 million, respectively, and they were combined with stock-based compensation expense in the consolidated statement of stockholders’ equity for the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2025 .
audit_findings.explanation: The unreconciled classification is a real denominator-versus-bridge question, but the supplied balance bounds the present exposure. Treating the entire $8.840 million as an additional claim reduces value by only $0.21/share; at the valuation-date price it is equivalent to roughly 0.050 million shares, about 0.12% of the 41.338 million denominator. Neither treatment could change the valuation conclusion, provided the obligation is counted once.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the June 30, 2026 participant share count and settlement elections, reconcile rabbi-trust shares to reported shares outstanding, and rerun with either incremental shares or the net unfunded cash claim, but not both.

audit_findings.title: Not all cash may be available to common shareholders at face value
audit_findings.magnitude: filed foreign cash of $136.6 million, or $3.30/share; total bridge cash of $450.526 million, or $10.90/share
audit_findings.mechanism: Repatriation tax, withholding, trapped cash, and required operating liquidity reduce the excess cash that can be added to the equity bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, our cash and cash equivalents consisted of deposits and money market funds held with established national financial institutions, and includes $152.1 million held in the local currencies of our foreign operations and could be subject to additional taxation if repatriated to the U.S.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing demonstrates that $136.6 million is foreign-held and potentially taxable, but the actual tax and minimum operating-cash requirement are unquantified. The issue is nevertheless bounded: even removing the entire $450.526 million cash balance lowers the bull value only to $97.92, still about 45% below the $177.56 market price. Thus no plausible cash-availability adjustment can reverse the conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Determine June 2026 cash by jurisdiction, repatriation tax and withholding, legal restrictions, and minimum operating-liquidity needs; rerun the bridge using only net excess distributable cash.
